paragraphs.text: Winota , Heartbonder is a human warrior on the plane of Ikoria .

Winota is one of the bonders , humans who form magical connections with the monsters of Ikoria. She told the planeswalker Vivien Reid how she lost her right arm trying to kill the monster that she ended up bonding with. Now Winota and her companion (which resembles a huge plated raccoon) travel Ikoria helping other bonders and monsters learn to fight side by side.
